notes.title: Low-end PC Optimization is Done
notes.content:
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] FPS dropping
[*] Light leaking
[*] Low quality textures
[*] Camera Lagging
[/list]

[b]Things reworked/redesigned[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall lighting - Cinematic lighting
[*] Character movement
[*] Added new jumpscare
[*] More spooky atmosphere
[/list]

[i][h1][b]New Upcoming Horror Game - Masked Menace 
Demo will be available in mid July.[/b][/h1][/i]

notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.content:
New gameplay added to the demo. Now you can play as wife(Ana) after playing/hearing husband's(John) story.
Time to reveal the unrevealed. Who would you believe now?
